historical_excavation_ratio.locator: printed page 41 / PDF page 3, citing 2002 sources
historical_excavation_ratio.interpretation: Historical site-count arithmetic; not a present excavation census and not an excavated-area fraction.

historical_excavation_ratio_primary_2002.locator: Publisher extract of Harappans and hunters: economic interaction and specialization in prehistoric India
historical_excavation_ratio_primary_2002.interpretation: The primary 2002 chapter reports 1056 Mature Harappan sites and 96 excavated. This historical alternative differs from the teaching chapter's 1022 denominator. Neither ratio describes the present inventory or excavated area.
historical_excavation_ratio_primary_2002.amendment_status: Added after the initial run following a source audit; run-v1 remains unchanged.

recent_review_count_separate_scope.interpretation: This review count is kept separate from the historical Mature-only denominators 1022 and 1056. No excavation ratio using 142 is calculated.

cholistan_remote_mounds.interpretation: Unmatched remote clusters require field checking and dating. These are not 266 confirmed new Indus sites. Visible-mound areas do not measure every occupation deposit.

southern_punjab_cartographic_revision.interpretation: The net revision is eight mapped features. Reconciliation and field dates are needed before counting new archaeological sites.
